work.title: Remove mutable manifest state from open Change branches
work.description: Stop writing or reconciling the current Work manifest inside the Change branch or its worktree. Executors receive orchestration information only through CLI responses, handoffs, and explicit inspection commands. Legacy branches that already contain a manifest projection remain readable but receive no new mutable checkpoints.
acceptance: New Change branches do not require a Work manifest file
Manifest checkpoints do not modify the Change branch
Worktrees do not need index reconciliation after manifest updates
Handoff generation remains complete without reading a branch manifest
Existing legacy branches continue to operate during migration
